title: schedule.calendar_sync_changed v1 (event payload)
description: Published by the schedule module, in the transaction in which a member turns one of their provider calendars on or off. The connectors module reads a calendar turned on again from the start (the calendar's cursor is dropped), and stops reading one turned off. Ids, a flag and a blob reference only: which calendar of the provider it is travels in the `provider_calendar` blob (a `calendar-ref` v1 document), since the provider's calendar id can be an address. Workspace-scoped.

calendar.description: The calendar (an id of the schedule module).

connection.description: The connection whose calendar it is (an id of the connectors module).

provider_calendar.description: Which calendar of the provider it is: a `calendar-ref` v1 document, a blob of the workspace. Optional: an event published without it names a calendar the connectors module cannot place, and is ignored.
